name: Hierarchical Volume Rendering for Cloud Surface
definition: A rendering method for cloud surfaces where the diffusion approximation is invalid, using hierarchical volume rendering with opacities ρ(X)σt and voxel colors I0(X).
summary: Hierarchical Volume Rendering for Cloud Surface renders cloud edges using least-squares octree approximations and hardware cell-projection compositing, distinguishing itself from standard methods by handling regimes where diffusion approximations fail.
